items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: And another fella by the name of P.O. Anderson. He was a, he used to be a trumpet player too and he got off trumpet and got on Suzy phone.

ctx.x: Yeah and charters and all. You don't see that. With the brass band. With the brass band. The lanny waltzes do you remember? Yeah. All of that time. Yeah they used to play all that on that style. Not so much ragtime. No not too much ragtime.

I wondered. I wondered. Did they, the parades down there. Did they have much of a, was it a big enough town they put on many parades? Or what did they do down there? Well in that time they had plenty of people. Because it was a sugar farm. They used to raise sugar can. You see in that time. You used to have plenty of people out there. There were a lot of people there. Yeah. They used to go from different plantation you know. Like they give outnings and the band used to go to different places and give outnings.…

Had you known Chris Kelly down in the country? Oh yeah. You knew him down there before you moved up? Oh yeah. Yeah Chris was a little bit of big under Chris. And he was bigger than, a good deal older then? Oh yeah he was way older.
